caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and four curved cabriole legs ending in pad feet. The table is light to medium brown in color, with visible wood grain throughout the surface. The front of the table has three drawers; the central drawer is slightly larger and is flanked by two smaller drawers. Each drawer has a brass or gold-colored handle with an ornate, traditional design. The apron beneath the tabletop and drawers features decorative curves and a central drop ornament. The overall composition centers the table on a light, unadorned background, with the entire piece rendered in a detailed, realistic style.
title: Lowboy
